column1: # GE-T10, the forms set: a narrowed slot and the word forms a question uses (SMYSL-2.5 OQ-88).
# A verify or explain question narrows `counter` and `reported` to the units that say one of
# its topic's words, and until this set `matches` compared words as spelled: "Is it true that
# citrus fruit cures scurvy?" narrowed to units saying `citrus`, `fruit` or `cures`, and the
# claim it asks about says "Scurvy is cured by oranges and lemons", so its rebuttal was never
# THE RULE, declared before this file was written and not changed after its first run:
#   26. A topic word also matches a word of a unit about the subject when the two have the
#       same stem under the question's language's analyzer chain — the chain that indexes the
#       library, through the entity port (`Entities::stems`). The language is the rule
#       table's, else `--lang`, else the guess `--misses` makes (`guess_lang`); with none, or
#       a port that cannot stem, nothing changes. The forms found are written into the slot's
#       text beside the topic's words, as `matches` alternatives, so the saved query carries
#       what ran. Only words of units about the subject are candidates: they are the units a
# THE SET. Each English verify and explain question of the gold and fresh sets, twenty-five,
# rewritten once with its topic's content words in another inflection of the same word —
# tense, number, a participle — and as little else changed as English allows. The qid is the
# original's, so each is scored against the original's gold slots (gold/slots.tsv,
# fresh/slots.tsv). Written by the hand that wrote the corpus, which knows what its units
# say; the set measures the mechanism, not how far it reaches into text nobody planned.
# THE GUARDS are the twenty-five originals, run beside the variants: a stem may join two
# words a spelling keeps apart, and a unit reached that way that the gold does not want is a
# loss of precision on questions that were already right.
# SCORED: `counter` and `reported`, precision and recall micro-averaged over (question, slot)
# pairs, end to end in English (`--lang en`), the subject through the production port. The
# baseline is `baseline.txt`, run before rule 26 existed. Kill: the guards' precision or
# recall falls, or the variants' precision falls below GE-T10's bar of 0.8.
